steps.content: Before her is a city that seems to have emerged from rock rifts. Winding paths spiral throughout, with crooked cave dwellings embedded haphazardly on the rock faces, their entrances extending outward into a collection of tents.
People move through this seemingly chaotic yet somehow orderly space, chattering away in a WhiteSands dialect that Hella can barely understand.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What is this place?
The young boy walks up to Hella, spreading his arms with a grin as he proudly announces.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Welcome to the safest place in all of WhiteSands, <color=#fb9259>Furor</color>, the city born out of rock rifts!

The black-robed figures remove their hoods, revealing kind, unassuming faces. They exchange greetings with townsfolk passing by, then gently nudge Hella forward while continuing their enthusiastic chatter in words she can't understand.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Old Rosse, over here! I'm back! Did you miss your dear Taric, old man?

The dark-skinned youth's voice booms across the distance, catching the attention of a man over ten meters away. The severe-looking man strides quickly toward them and promptly seizes the boy by his ear!

steps.speaker: Rosse
steps.content: ...Miss you? As if! You troublemaker, this is our last sand boat. If you wreck it, where are we supposed to get another one, huh?
After finally releasing his grip, the stern-faced man turns to Hella, his gaze piercing.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: He-hello...?
The man's brow furrows, sending Hella into a state of panic. Her mind races desperately for something to say. Is her cover about to be blown?

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: We just rescued this girl from the DisCity traffickers! She only understands the common tongue. They probably kidnapped her from somewhere near DisCity, and now she can't get back home. Poor thing!
The crowd gathered nearby falls silent for a few seconds. In the next instant, all the Furorians are swarming around Hella.

steps.speaker: Angry Townie
steps.content: Those ******* bastards! Have they no shame, getting into this kind of dirty trade?!

steps.speaker: Kind Townie
steps.content: Are you hurt? Poor child, look how they've starved you... Where are you from, honey? How did you end up captured by the DisCity people?
Their speech is a mixture of WhiteSands dialect and heavily-accented Disian. Concerned that Hella may not understand, they slow down deliberately, carefully enunciating each word.
Though Hella still can't understand much, the concern on their faces seems genuine. Glancing over at Taric, she catches him giving her a thumbs up with an encouraging look.
But... she can't mention DisCity or the MBCC, and she needs these people to believe her. What kind of false identity should she make up? As Hella ponders this, inspiration strikes.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: M-my name is Hella, and I used to live in a place called... uh, Tuco!
As they say, the first step is always the hardest.

The lies come more and more easily as Hella continues, her voice breaking with tears as she describes how Tuco went from a prosperous town into a barren wasteland, recounting a perfect tearjerker about a poor kidnapped child.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It was just a tiny town not far from DisCity, but life was decent enough. Then disasters got worse and Hypercubes became too expensive. When we couldn't pay our debts, those DisCity thugs kidnapped all of us to sell for profit...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Sob... Thank you all so much. If you hadn't saved me, who knows where they would have sold me off to...
Her performance is so convincing that all the townspeople listen with bitter indignation.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Hmph, told you there's not a decent soul in DisCity! Someone who ran away to that place told me they even detonated massive bombs called Black Rings in the city! For all we know, they might even be behind all these disasters everywhere—owww—!
A hand grabs Taric by the ear and yanks him away.

steps.speaker: Rosse
steps.content: Don't listen to his nonsense. Here, have some candy.

The man produces some coarse brown sugar wrapped in a wrinkled piece of oilpaper. The sugar lumps have been broken into irregular small pieces, nothing like the refined candies from DisCity, but his careful handling suggests it's a precious commodity here.

steps.speaker: Rosse
steps.content: Merchants don't pass through here, so our town has nothing proper to offer as a welcome gift. Still, we'll have no problem taking care of one more kid.
Huh? She recalls the maps she's seen from Horo. This place isn't that far from the trade routes... Could it be because of that strange magnetic storm outside?
Remembering her intel-gathering mission, Hella's eyes dart cunningly as she rubs them and makes her voice sound even more pitiful and distressed.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: I've never seen anything like that sandstorm out there. It was chasing after us and was even making strange noises... Have the sandstorms around here always been like this?
The Furorians exchange glances with each other and sigh.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: I suppose so. Those DisCity folks were foolish enough to charge right into it. It was a suicidal move.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What happened to the Legion... I mean, those guys from DisCity? Where did they go? Will they come back to do more bad things?

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Those guys? They were probably taken underground. There's a special place down there where bad people get locked up.
Hella peers around, trying to spot the underground place Taric mentioned, when she feels a weight on her head. Taric ruffles her hair and leads her toward the town center.

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Don't worry! You're one of us now. Those DisCity thugs won't ever get to hurt you again!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: This is Granny Nysa, the best doctor you can ever find. You can go to her with any health problems. And that's Old Rosse—don't mind his grumpy face. Most of the caverns here were in fact designed by him. He's among the coolest guys in Furor!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: And there's little curly-haired Zade over there, always waving those raggedy cards around. Feel free to mess with him a bit if you ever find yourself bored. Promise you it's fun!
In Hella's eyes, those are merely some cards printed with colorful patterns, nothing like the real stuff she's seen before.

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: Stop laughing! And they're not raggedy! These are real tarot cards and they're very valuable!

Eager to prove his fortune-telling skills, Zade pulls a card from his deck. It shows a crude drawing of something tall and skinny with an indistinguishable shape. Zade explains that this is a symbol of... um, possibly a long loaf of bread?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Pfft... Hahaha!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh right, I saw someone earlier standing by a window up there. She seemed different from everyone else. Is she a Furorian too?

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Oh! You're talking about Hypatia from the lab!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Who's that?
At the mention of Hypatia's name, Zade immediately rushes over, throwing his arms up and stretching them wide to form an enormous circle.

steps.speaker: Zade
steps.content: Hypatia always comes down to play with us, and she brings me snacks every time. She's the most super-duper nicest person ever!

steps.speaker: Granny Nysa
steps.content: Indeed, she helped us build our town and kept us fed. If it weren't for the <color=#fb9259>Campbells</color>, Furor might still be nothing more than a shabby shelter today...
Campbell...? Are they talking about that girl?

Looking around, the town definitely has facilities with technology far beyond what you'd expect from a small settlement. Equipment of such caliber and quality is not seen in just any small town in WhiteSands.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: She doesn't even look much older than me... Is she really that remarkable?

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Of course! I mean, look!
Taric guides Hella to look up. At the top of Furor, an irregular circle of rocks seems to hang in the sky.

Looking closer, there seems to be something in the air that briefly illuminates when struck, forming a network of glittering points. Outside, the storm continues to rage, darkening the sky, yet unable to reach the city.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Not Hypercubes... Never seen anything like that even in DisCity! How did you guys pull that off?!

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Hmph, with our great Lady Campbell here, what can possibly stop us?

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: She's the one who brought <color=#fb9259>Aurum Secretum</color> from Fraser, which blocks Mania and contamination. You can basically take a stroll outside during a storm with it! Even without Hypercubes, Furor stands strong thanks to this barrier...

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: With her around, this is the safest place in all of WhiteSands!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Aurum Secretum?
Taric continues talking enthusiastically, but Hella's attention has already been caught by something else he mentioned.
<color=#fb9259>Aurum Secretum</color>... It was probably what saved us. If this stuff is really that powerful, then...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Ahem, so what does this Aurum something look like anyway? Can we use it too?
Taric thumps his own chest proudly and runs back to the sand boat they arrived on, unloading an oddly shaped metal device from the cabin.
He presses something on the device, and with a soft humming sound, it slowly rotates and unfolds, emitting the same fluorescent glow as the barrier.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Whoa? It's actually the real deal...

Ideas start popping into her head. The Aurum Secretum's right here, should I make a move now? No, no, no, too many pairs of eyes. I still need to find a way to rescue Horo... But if I miss this chance, who knows when I'll get my hands on this precious stuff again...

steps.speaker: Taric
steps.content: Though production is still low now, someday it'll replace Hypercubes throughout WhiteSands, and then we won't have to fear DisCity attacking us again! With Aurum Secretum in our hands, who knows, we might even beat them!
...Attack again?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait, what do you mean DisCity attacking <color=#fb9259>again</color>...?
[Transition for 2s, attack sound effects, screen shakes]
The city's alarm suddenly goes off.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ?! Oh crap, don't tell me someone's actually attacking??
...No, that's not it. There's a shattering sound from high above. Hella looks up in horror, just in time to see a crack spreading in the once-solid defensive barrier.
The next moment, a sharp claw tears through the barrier. Sandy wind and Mania rush into the city.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Watch out! Something's breaking through!
